backend.description: Backend module to load; for PulseAudio this must be 'pulse'.

oss_socket.description: Unix socket path or OSS device path to expose for OSS clients.

max_clients.description: Maximum number of concurrent audio client sessions (e.g., applications opening /dev/dsp).

sample_rate.description: Target sample rate (Hz) for digital audio conversion (e.g., 44100, 48000, 96000).

channels.description: Number of audio channels: 1 for mono, 2 for stereo.

buffer_size_ms.description: Audio buffer latency in milliseconds; lower = more responsive, higher = more stable.

auto_detect.description: If true, automatically detect and use the system’s default PulseAudio sink/source. If false, use the 'Device' value.

device.description: PulseAudio sink (for output) or source (for input) name to use when AutoDetect=false.

resample.description: If true, enable software resampling when hardware cannot match the requested sample rate.

acls.description: List of client access control rules; evaluated in order. Each rule is a pattern (e.g., 'allow *', 'deny *').

pa_properties.description: List of key=value PulseAudio properties to apply (as 'property = value' lines).
